slide-title.purpose: One heading per page at the top margin.

components.name: Panel
components.description: Raised flat rectangle with ink outline.

narrative.overview: Every page is a 1920 by 1080 sheet read as a PDF, so it behaves like paper: cool ground, navy ink, flat rectangles, hairlines. Colour is a vocabulary: teal for genuine, magenta for synthetic, everything else ink or grey.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper grounds, navy ink, two meaning-bearing accents
Flat surfaces: 2-3px ink outlines or tint fills, square corners
Colour always paired with a word and a shape
Archivo 800 titles, Archivo Narrow labels, sparing Kalam hand notes
Fixed 128px margins, one-line footer with source and section counter

rules.name: The Two Meanings Rule
rules.body: Teal and magenta mean genuine and synthetic and nothing else.

rules.name: The Never Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status colour is paired with a word and a glyph or outline style.

rules.name: The 24px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set below 24px; footers sit at exactly 24px.

rules.name: The Hindi Once Rule
rules.body: The wordmark appears on the cover only.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are rectangles with an outline or a tint; no shadows, gradients or glass.

dos: Do set pages on paper, alternate paper-deep, put panels on paper-raised.
Do pair every status colour with a word and a glyph or outline style.
donts: Don't use teal or magenta as decoration, a button colour, or on stamps and placeholders.
Don't add gradients, shadows, glass, photographs, faces, emoji or motion.
